authority.document: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

scope: Physical bit spans and peer-decoded values for the initial HEADER prefix in the existing generated AC1012 pair.
checks: An independent Python bit walker records contiguous start/end bits and values for 90 prefix fields, covering 1,096 bits of each file from the payload start through CELTSCALE; values agree with LibreDWG 0.14 minJSON, including the null hard-pointer role.
A changed DIMASO flag, invalid bitdouble tag, and wrong viewport-handle role are rejected even after the HEADER CRC is repaired; restoring the original bytes passes a clean retry.
The shared prefix check also runs within the existing 32-object source census; both drawings and the focused legacy BLOCK_HEADER probe pass.
Source-release inventory check and self-test pass; drawings remain in scratch storage.
limits: The two controls are LibreDWG-generated and LibreDWG supplies the peer decode; this is independent of libdxfrw but not an independent producer.
The remaining HEADER body and handle graph, defaults, complete export, native open and clone semantics are not qualified. No general DWG or DXF support claim follows.
